title: The wars of independence: the case of Mexico
goal: I can tell the story of the Mexican war of independence from the Grito de Dolores to 1821.
grammar: Preterite and imperfect: telling the war

items: I can say what Hidalgo did on 16 September 1810.
I can say what happened to Hidalgo and Morelos.
I can explain how Mexico became independent in 1821.
I can say that Brazil became independent in a different way.
I can use the preterite and the imperfect to tell events and describe the background.
